Inline markers inside a code span stay literal content

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<p><code>a<em>b</em><ins>c</ins></code></p>");
var_dump($result->content);
```
